reviews.text: We had a bit of a scare with our sausage dog the team of super helpful and very very professional in how they dealt with things I would highly recommend them

Highly recommend.
They were very accommodating of my kids (they did some colouring in), the staff were very friendly and professional, and the whole feel of the place was calm.
Sadly it was a difficult time for our lovely cat Peggy, but the staff couldn’t have been more compassionate and caring. Easy to book an appointment and good communication too.

Called them about an injured stray I've been seeing in my garden who is not putting any weight on his front leg now needs help. They told me I need to register him as my own and pay for a consultation before they would even do anything for me. Quite sad to see how little they care for animal welfare when it really comes to it.
absolutely loveee the girls Helen and Jess, even though I arrived late they still provided exceptional service to me and my girls and I left feeling so much more confident. Thank you guys xx
Amazing customer service, so helpful and supportive. Really recommend.

I had a really positive experience here, owing majorly to the friendliness of the receptionist and the vet that I saw. Communication from the practice has been great too. Additionally, my emergency appointment was secured extremely promptly. I would happily take my pet here again.

Dear Nastassia,
Thanks so much for leaving us this review, we really appreciate it. We'd love to keep in touch - feel free to WhatsApp or drop in if you're ever in the area.
Best wishes, Hannah

Went in today and was met with dr holly. She was fantastic! Really listened to my concerns regarding my fur baby and she was really taking everything on board and gave some amazing advice. Highly recommend !!

I've been with Hello Vet for about a year now, the only reason I switched vets was because they were just a little bit closer than my previous vets.

But my god. I think this place is amazing. And more importantly, so does Jenny (my dog).

Gone are the anxious moments in the  office like waiting room with her scrambling to get out at any moment . She genuinely loves going there, the on hand treats probably help. The reception staff always show a lot love to her and they're good for a nice chat whilst you're waiting.

And every vet I've seen has been enthusiastic and explained things clearly and professionally to me. And also been super kind to Jenny.

I won't lie,  they're just a little bit more expensive than my previous vets, who were fine , but I think I'm getting a far better service and the experience seems more customer (both me and Jenny) first, so I'm happy.

Hello Vet, I really hope you treat your staff well, they're your greatest asset.

100% recommend.

This was my first visit today with my dog. It was a lovely calm environment to wait in, and the staff were warm, kind and friendly. My dog seemed relaxed and happy and the whole experience was very good. They followed up promptly will all the details of the visit, I was hugely impressed and I though the costing was very reasonable. A lovely local vet practice!
First time taking our adopted cat. Rowan was  so friendly and understanding and helpful. Follow up texts daily would highly recommend
This vet is excellent!

Brilliant experience.
I was looking for a vet to take my cat to, and this one really stood out. Their website is clear and transparent about the treatments they offer and what you’re expected to pay, which I really appreciated. Booking an appointment was quick and easy, and the visit itself went smoothly. They were very accommodating to our needs. The day after the appointment, they even messaged to check in on my cat, which really shows how dedicated and caring the team is. I couldn’t be happier with the experience.

Calm, professional and friendly service.
Very attentive follow up WhatsApp service.
We love HelloVet. Been to 3 branches so far and has an excellent experience throughout.

Very pleased overall with my first visit here today for my cats' boosters and annual health check. The vet examined them with a thoroughness I've not seen in 25 years of having cats, and he gave advice on monitoring my ginger's heart murmur that no other vet has. Also nice that there's no hard sell for Hill's food that comes with other practices. Great venue, too; the most calming atmosphere I've seen, with treats available in the waiting area.

I absolutely love this vet! As soon as I message the team on WhatsApp, I’m able to get an appointment—often the very same day or the next. They’re always so easy to communicate with and incredibly quick to reply. The nurses and vets are genuinely lovely, and we’ve visited both the Clapton and London Fields branches with great experiences each time. I’m so happy I switched from my old vet to Hello Vet—they’re simply the kindest, most efficient, and most caring team for my dog!

We had a very positive experience with Hello Vet!
We came to them after our cat injured her foot, when our only option with our usual vet was to wait another three days for yet another visit (for what seemed like, and was, a straightforward infected wound). Hello Vet got us in quickly, treated the infection properly right away, and were so caring throughout. They discussed the options with us, explained their assessment clearly, and made sure we understood the treatment plan. The team was friendly, the clinic felt welcoming, and the prices were much fairer. We also really appreciated the WhatsApp follow-up and the extra advice about flea treatment. So glad we found them!

Great vets. Was able to get an appointment quickly after a scary incident with my elderly dog. They were very thorough and detailed and even gave me a follow up call to check how she was doing the following day. Very pleased that I made the switch from another local vetinary practice.

It's like walking into a doggy Spa.Very calming as soon as you walk through the door.I smiling face at the reception.The different Vets we had a consultation with were outstanding, really interested,and had time to cuddle our shaking Maltipoo,who after getting his  Booster jab,was running around happily in the room while we were still exchanging information and future care plan. It was an amazing experience and I made sure to tell all my friends with dogs about it. We also have a new Puppy and my daughter attended his first appointment for 2nd Vaccination,and she was the one saying we should swap 1 year old over to this Vet.Best choice we made.
Thank you team for your hard work and that you genuinely still really care.
Regards Andrea
Impeccable service and space, packed with  caring professional humans. We feel so happy and safe  to now have them around the corner!

Super experience so far with Hello Vet. Really easy to get on touch with and get advice from, appointments available at short notice including evenings and weekends. Vet is knowledgeable and gave clear explanations and instructions.
They were fantastic; the WhatsApp chat made everything smooth, booking was easy, and the team were genuinely friendly, caring, and welcoming.
Lovely place, excellent service, no extra charge

I could not have had a better experience if I’d tried. Staff are professional, friendly and warm. They clearly truly love animals and want to support you and your pets the best they can. I have both visited in the surgery and used their text service. I felt comfortable asking any questions, big or small. I had been anxious about taking my cats but they had a great experience. I would recommend hello vet to anyone.

The premises are fresh and new and carefully thought out. Reception and the vet consultation were great. They were  very professional, yet were friendly and kind too. My cat needs dental surgery, but as "my" branch  isn't equipped to do this, I will need to take him to their London Fields branch. I expect he will receive the best care. I am nervous about any cat, especially a 15-year-old like mine, being anaesthetised, but I felt assured by the vet who saw my boy recently. The only glitch was that the entrance doorway wasn't wheelchair-friendly. That said, the receptionist and my carer managed to wrangle me over the threshold. A portable ramp was discussed.
Lovely vet surgery, really reasonable pricing and very friendly staff :)

Such an amazing vet clinic! 💛
They’re always in touch, checking up after every visit and really care about the animals. The way they treat pets is just incredible.
Honestly, I was a bit jealous of my cat Simon – I wish doctors looked after me the same way 😊.
Can’t recommend them enough!
These guys are the best at what they do , they really care about the wellbeing of the animals that come into their care. I highly recommend them. Thank you guys so much

We had a great first experience with Hello Vet: really great to be able to chat to them over WhatsApp before coming in, and we were able to get an appointment on the same day. All of the staff were really friendly and the clinic is very spacious (and doesn't smell like a vets), which was great for our slightly nervous dog. Once in the consultation, the vet took the time to make our dog feel relaxed and was able to treat his ear infection with almost no fuss which is a first as he hates having his ears looked at. Treatment options and costs were explained to us so we could make a decision on what was the best route, and it is helpful to have the treatment plan sent over after the appointment too. All in all, a really great experience. We'd definitely recommend Hello Vet to anyone in the area.

We are so happy to have chosen Hello Vet for our cats neutering. We felt very welcomed all the staff were very friendly and kind. We only got the amout of medication we needed so we weren't over charged. Very pleased with the service. Thank you for making me feel you cared about my cat.

Very easy to get an appointment. The two vets we saw were very good and helpful. Mishka (dog) is reactive on the lead in confined spaces and they take this into account when making appointments which makes the whole experience far less stressful.
I feel this is a very good vetenary service, only looses a star as I feel it may be a little more expensive than the vet my friends use.
I would recommend Hello Vet, I think it is an independent vet rather than part of a chain, which I like and I feel they genuinely care about providing good care for iur furry friends.

Absolutely brilliant vet. The what’s app communication is such a great feature and they are so quick to respond. The service across their branches is the best I have experienced from any vets before. Friendly, kind and helpful. The interior of the vets it’s pretty cool too and my dogs always get a little treat when they visit. It’s not cheap (I’m not sure how it compares to other vets in terms of price) but I would highly recommend!

We took our adopted cat Olive to the vet for a check up this week. We've regularly gone to another prevoosuly independent vet in Clapton with our beloved old puss. Our neighbours had highly recommended Hello vet recently after a serious emergency with their feline so we decided to give them a go. We were really happy with the experience.  Booking an appointment was a breeze and communication was very fast - no longer having to ring multiple times and hope someone answered was so very welcome. The premises are spotless and very modern - a breath of fresh air! We found the staff were welcoming and the vet very attentive and helpful. Prices were about the same as other vets locally. Really highly recommend Hello Vet and shall be returning here for all future feline care.
Very friendly receptionist and vet. So far a very positive experience and loving the follow up communication. I also love the idea of being able to WhatsApp photos if I have a concern.
Such a great vet, highly recommend

The vet was very friendly and explained how my newly acquired dog had been chipped in Poland an imported from USA
He was also very reassuring about my dog being hesitant to walk
He was very kind when my dog had a wee inside
I would strongly recommend Hello Vet to anyone
So far loving the experience with Hello Vet, very smooth and efficient digitally savvy comms with lovely caring staff behind the scenes!

What a lovely vet practice!
My initial inquiry resulted in a response by WhatsApp. Response time was superfast and when I got an appointment to go and see them they were so lovely. You are greeted with smiles, It's a lovely light open plan waiting area, and just a lovely all round experience 😊

I would wholeheartedly recommend this practice.

I recently visited the Chatsworth Road clinic with my cat, who is very difficult with vets as he gets frightened and fights back hard before anyone even gets near him. The team there were wonderful with him, kind and patient, both while we were waiting and in the treatment room, and on the run up to the appointment too.
Love this vet. And the WhatsApp triage service is brilliant.

Hello Vet Clapton were incredibly accommodating and informative. We were uncertain on a few things but they put our minds at ease and provided a very calming and comfortable environment for us and our puppy

Great first vet trip for Manny. The receptionist was lovely and Dr Olivia was very thorough with her consultation. She was also incredibly caring and comforting, something necessary for my anxious kitten
Really friendly vets with great service. Ted the Labrador had a great first trip to the vets. WhatsApp access to vets/nurses it great for questions in between visits
Very friendly and professional 👏 …

Had a wonderful experience at Hello Vet Clapton. It was my puppy’s first trip to the vet and the team made us feel so welcome and that we were in the best hands! We were given lots of pats and treats. Dr Olivia was brilliant. So lucky to have such a great local vet!

Very useful-friendly, reasonably priced and I didn’t feel I was being pushed into paying for unnecessary treatment. A refreshing change! The use of WhatsApp to book appointments and communicate follow-up really worked.
Great experience thank you hello Vet

We use these guys recently, and I must say I’ve been blown away by their service and after-care follow-up. Will definitely use them again! They were also so flexible in us changing our appointment times, Top stars!

Many thanks for taking the time to leave us a review! We are glad you had a positive experience at our clinic. If you need anything else, you know where to find us! Have a lovely week,
Your Hello Vet Team
Excellent service and patient care, at a good price.
Hello vet have been amazing from the day we joined. Such a lovely clean spacious and calm setting, always get an appointment sometimes even the same day! Even our nervous rescue likes going there!
Friendly customer service & great veterinary knowledge!

I took my Australian labradoodle here and she was looked after so well. The vet practice itself is beautiful, I've never been in one so nice. She was given lots of cuddles and care and everyone was really friendly especially the receptionist. The vet was very knowledgeable and great with my dog. She also got some treats to take home and she is obsessed with them. We will be using this as our regular vet 🧡
P.s my dog is my queen and my entire world so this is really saying something 🤣🫶🏼

Very pet friendly and welcoming staff.
Bright clean modern environment
Good transparent consultation and explanations from the vet
So glad I found you guys!
The team are so lovely and attention
Everyone was so kind. My puppy was pretty nervous but they took good care of her. Explained everything and was more than willing to answer any questions I had
Thank you for leaving us a positive review! Have a lovely rest of the week. Kind regards, Gloria
From the first visit we have enjoyed the polite and kind nature of the nurses and doctors. My favourite part is the delivery of post visit notes emailed to me for reference

A really warm welcome for humans and pets. I was seen on time and my dog was given a very thorough examination, at no point was I sold any treatment that wasn't necessary.  I'm impressed by the clarity amd communication. I was given lots of  clear pricing, options and timeliness for treatment going forwards. I appreciate clarity and the nature of the communication. I was recommended this practice and can see why!
Such a great vets. Can’t recommend enough. Great for first time puppy owners like myself -  super helpful, friendly and attentive

We live just five minutes away and were so happy to see a new clinic open in our neighborhood — especially since we had just adopted a 1.5-year-old French Bulldog. Shortly after registering, our dog unfortunately developed a serious issue. We were incredibly grateful that the clinic fit us in just 30 minutes after our call!

The service was outstanding. The vet showed genuine care and took all the time needed — we never felt rushed. We felt like part of the family, not just clients.

The online support is also fantastic: we get advice, consultations, or even calls depending on the situation — no waiting for days, no queues. After such a great experience, we transferred our second Frenchie to Hello Vet Hackney too!

We’d give 10 stars if we could — but five will have to do!
Our annual check up for my two cats went super smoothly like always, they are both very relaxed whenever they have to go Hello Vet and loved the treat bags they gave us when we left!

Hello Vet have completely transformed my experience of vets. The clinics are beautiful, modern and warm and their focus is always making my pets feel comfortable and safe before anything else. They have treated my cat Prince and dog Stevie who are both super nervous due to previous negative experiences at vets and both times I’ve been so impressed. The WhatsApp line is super useful too and they’re always responsive.

Hi Sophie, thank you so much for the 5 star rating! It means a lot. If you need anything, you know where to find us!
Have a lovely evening, Hannah

Even though this vets is further away than our local we’re very happy we chose them. They’ve completely reinvented the veterinary experience with transparent fees, a friendly service and WhatsApp messages to speak to the vet before & after you book an appointment. Very happy so far
We’ve had a great experience with Hello Vet for our mini Daschund. Whether it’s been check ups or tooth removal, they’re great vets and really good at communicating too. Many thanks

Lovely vet, extra care taken to calm my cat down with some calming spray whilst waiting and some treats. Really nice, clean environment and fantastic care.  Extremely quick to respond and booking an appointment, I would definitely recommend.
They made my dog feel very welcomed and took care of her needs and provided us with an Animal Healthcare Certificate. Very friendly people, highly recommend.

We moved over to Hello Ver after having a negative experience with our local Medivet and will never go back! Our dog, Buddy, is quite anxious and they really took care of him and showed him so much empathy and care, which our previous vet didn’t do at all. They were really helpful, informative and also transparent about costs before you agree to going forward with any treatments. So glad we moved!

I found Hello, vets in Clapton
An absolute pleasure to visit with my cat The staff was not only nice to deal with they never tried to push any products onto me which for a vets is a huge change
I have already booked my next appointment

Hi Jon,
Thank you for taking the time to leave us 5 stars, it's truly appreciated. Do reach out if you need anything!
Best wishes, Hannah
Amazing staff!!!!
Very friendly my little milo felt safe and happy. They're fast with appointments and keep an efficient pace with messages and always having amazing communication. Would definitely recommend

Our first visit to Hello vet was lovely, the team are kind and friendly. Suki our 13 year old cat was as comfortable as she could be and was allowed to have a sniff around the consultation room. Our vet was very cat conscious and also the politeness of the reception staff was great too.
My only warning is that there isn’t much parking near the surgery so worth having 5 mins extra to park and walk

Hi Eve,
Thanks so much for leaving us a rating! It means a lot that you took time out to do this, we really appreciate it. If you ever need anything, you know how to reach us!
Enjoy your day, 
Hannah
Lovely staff. And the vet christian is very nice and patient with my nervous Ridgeback.

Hi Daisy,
Thank you for leaving us 5 stars, it's really appreciated. Have a lovely rest of your week!
Best wishes, 
Hannah

Hello Vet is a welcome addition to the high street. Always a friendly welcome (for dogs and guardians), caring consultation and clear treatment approach. The team do everything they can to help animals feel relaxed and at ease. And the clinic is beautifully designed, with lovely touches like the treat bar, and sunken weighing scales. Highly recommend a visit.
Hey Barbie. Thank you for the five stars. So glad you’ve had a good experience at Hello Vet. Sending our best wishes to you and your pet. Joanna
The best vet ever !!! I love they have whatsapp and are super reliable , friendly and always have myself and kitty at total ease. Would never go anywhere else

I took my little cat Ziggy to see Hello Vet on Clapton Road to get worming tablets and to have a general check up. They could not have been lovelier! The whole visit was calm, friendly and thorough. Ziggy was very much at ease as a result which made what could have been a stressful encounter an absolute breeze. I would thoroughly recommend Hello Vet and am delighted that they have just opened a branch around the corner from me!

We have recently moved to Hello Vet’s Clapton practice after hearing wonderful things from friends, and it lived up to expectations at our first appointment! Communication is great and getting an appointment is super easy (within just a few days). The clinic itself is beautiful and calm - everyone was so kind and welcoming, making it a real positive experience for my dog. The vet, Hannah, made me feel listened to and taken seriously, and like we had plenty of time to be seen with patience and not rushed through. All the options were discussed so I was confident with the treatment plan, and I got clear written notes via email afterwards. My dog loved it because she got a special bag of treats with her name on to take home with her and everyone gave her lots of attention! I’ll definitely be recommending to others.
Every vet should be like hello vet! Amazing standards and service.

I cannot rate Hello Vet highly enough. Originally, I moved our young dog there so I could be with her when she fell asleep for her spay operation. I have been so impressed by their super caring friendly customer service, and the speed and ease, and help, they have given me and my lovely dog.

I have been incredibly pleased with the quality and ease of care that has been offered to our new puppy Zoey. The staff has made everything as easy as possible from booking appointments to follow up queries. One thing I don’t have to worry about is whether Zoey will get the best care because I know she will at Hello Vet.

From start to finish, the entire team at Hello Vet was incredibly warm and kind! The space is modern and exudes a bright, open atmosphere that sets it apart from traditional veterinary clinics. The doctor was knowledgeable, attentive, and friendly, taking the time to ensure we felt comfortable and empowered with our new puppy Hero. We’re so grateful to have found Hello Vet!
The staff are friendly and welcoming. Seen promptly and given good advice. Premises are clean and spacious.

I recently visited with my dog Jonah, who's an elderly gentleman. Really impressed with the service. The vet was very attentive and friendly, and their WhatsApp communication made everything super easy and stress-free. It was easy to book an appointment and quick response times and booking! Everyone we've met has been friendly and professional. Highly recommend — so much care and attention, something that is very much needed with vets!

I recently visited Hello Vet’s new Clapton clinic with my cat, Cola, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The team, especially the vet Dr. Julia, was exceptional - kind, professional, and clearly passionate about providing the best care. She got to the bottom of what was causing weight loss and diagnosed her ibs. The new diet she recommended is already making a world of difference!! Cola isn’t the easiest patient, but they handled her with such care and patience that it really put me at ease.
The communication on WhatsApp was a game-changer. Super convenient for organising Cola’s appointment and they swiftly answered questions after my visit, too. The clinic itself is beautiful and brand new.
Highly recommend.

The booking and follow up process via Whatsapp was very easy! I felt at ease knowing I could plan my pet's visit this way during a busy work day when calls aren't always possible! The staff have been so nice and helpful.

I’m very happy to be one of this vet’s first reviews. What an absolute breath of fresh air this company is. The spaces are wonderful and light and airy with touches like the scales built into the floor. You think this is trivial, but when you own a dog who knows that stepping onto the scale at the vet might be followed by an unpleasant experience, then just making that step of the process gentle makes such a huge difference …

So far, nothing is anymore expensive than any other vet I’ve used in London over 20 years of owning a dog. The staff are lovely, the vets are knowledgeable and have helped me sort out a tricky injured claw on our dog.

We live around the corner from the Clapton office and am looking forward to being part of the Hello Vet family. Hopefully we don’t have to use the London Fields office for anything serious and we can just pop in around the corner when needed. Welcome to the ‘hood, Frida Dog and I are excited you’re here.
Another great experience. This time at the new branch. Would highly recommend.

We were one of the first customers of Clapton and absolutely loved the experience. They fit us in fast for an urgent appointment. The vet and front desk were both really kind. The prices were reasonable. The WhatsApp communication feature is extremely useful. Overall, would definitely recommend to anyone else, especially if you’ve just moved to the area or just got a new pet and want a loving go-to vet!

The new hello vet in clapton is amazing. My cat went to get her nails cut and Hailey did it with ease leaving my cat happy. The practice looks great and staff are very welcoming. I have recommended to family and friends. Teenie is booked in for next month. Thanks hello vet.
Very friendly vet and nurse, lovely environment and very patient service for all of our questions. Also the WhatsApp support and help is invaluable for first time pet owners. Highly recommend!

My dog Archie is not a patient of Hello Vet but he was incredibly unwell this morning and I found on Google a way to speak to a vet. I wrote to Hello Vet and within 30 minutes they had answered me with wonderful advice and then throughout the following two hours messaged me to see how he was doing and to comfort me..I want to say thank you so much for their prompt reply and Excellent care of me during a very upsetting time and I wasn't even registered at their place. I would highly recommend ommend to anyone. Thank you so much.🙏
